reply_text:
I replied to Fintan in his DM to confirm I've noted it: from now on, Wren Varno is his go-to escalation contact at Dreyness Brewing Co. for the Jasper rollout. He said no action was needed, so I didn't change or send anything else.

His message was already saved in gbrain automatically, so I didn't add a duplicate. But the brain lists that saved fact as visible to "world", even though the install guide says a DM stays private to that member. If that label means it really is shared more widely, other members could find his private contact preference. I haven't changed it, because that means deleting and re-saving his fact and he didn't ask for that. It's worth having the brain owner check how DM facts are being stored. I won't repeat what he told me anywhere else.
